title: GOD OF DIVINE INTERVENTION, INTERCEDE FOR ME | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Father God, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before you today as someone who has exhausted every human resource, who has tried every natural solution, who has knocked on every earthly door, and now I'm standing at heaven's gate crying out for divine intervention for you to step in where I cannot, to do what I cannot do, to move in ways that define natural explanation because your word declares in Mark 10:27 that with God all things are possible. And I need you to do the impossible in my situation right now.

I need you to intervene in a way that only you can intervene. I need you to show up in a way that silences every skeptic, that amazes every observer, that proves beyond a shadow of a doubt that you are God and you are real and you are powerful and you are faithful. And I'm not asking timidly. I'm asking boldly. I'm knocking urgently. I'm crying out desperately because I know that you specialize in intervention. You are known throughout history as the God who shows up when all seems lost. God of divine intervention.

I'm reminded of when the Red Sea stood as an impossibly high wall before the Israelites with Pharaoh's army charging behind them. There was no way through, no way around, no way over, no way back. They were trapped. They were doomed. They were facing certain death. And yet, according to Exodus 14 21-22, Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

The children of Israel went into the midst of the sea on the dry ground and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left. And that's the kind of divine intervention I need right now. I need you to part what seems impossible, to open what seems closed, to create a way where there is no way, to do what defies all logic and reason and natural law. Because the same God who parted the Red Sea is my God today. I'm standing before my own Red Sea right now.

Lord, an obstacle so massive it seems immovable. A barrier so high it seems unscalable. A problem so complicated it seems unsolvable. And I'm crying out to you for divine intervention. I'm asking you to stretch out your hand like you did for Moses. To move mountains like you've promised. to do the impossible like you've demonstrated throughout history.

Because according to Isaiah 43 16-17, thus says the Lord who makes a way in the sea and a path through the mighty waters, who brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power, they shall lie down together, they shall not rise. They are extinguished, they are quenched like a weak. So make a way for me, Lord.

Create a path for me through this impossible situation and bring me through to the other side and let everyone who sees what happens know that you did it that your hand was involved that your power was demonstrated because I want to give you glory for the intervention that only you can provide. God of divine intervention. I remember Shedrach, Meshach, and Abednego in Daniel 3 who were thrown into a furnace of fire. so hot that the men who threw them in were killed by the heat.

But according to Daniel 3:24:25, Nebuchadnezzar was astonished and rose in haste and spoke, saying, "Did we not cast three men bound into the midst of the fire?" And he answered and said, "True, O king." And he continued and said, "Look, I see four men loose walking in the midst of the fire, and they are not hurt, and the form of the fourth is like the son of God. They were in the fire, but the fire could not burn them. They were surrounded by flames, but flames could not consume them.

And when they came out of the fire, their hair was not singed, their garments were not burned, and there was not even the smell of fire on them. And that's the kind of divine intervention I need. I need you to be with me in my fire, to protect me in my trial, to preserve me through my persecution, to keep me safe in my storm, to be my fourth man in the midst of my furnace. The enemy has thrown me into fires thinking they would consume me, thinking they would destroy me, thinking they would end my story.

But I'm asking for divine intervention. I'm asking for you to show up in the flames. I'm asking for you to walk with me through the trial. And I declare according to Isaiah 43 22 23 that when I pass through the waters, you will be with me and through the rivers there will not overflow me. When I walk through the fire, I shall not be burned, nor shall the flames scorch me. For you are the Lord my God, the Holy One of Israel, my Savior.

So even though I'm in intense heat right now, even though the pressure is intense, even though everything around me is burning, I'm standing on the promise that you are with me. And I will come through this trial, not destroyed, but refined, not burned, but blessed, not consumed, but strengthened. I'm calling for divine intervention in my physical situation. Lord, I need you to show up where doctors have given up. I need you to heal where medicine has failed.

I need you to restore where degeneration seemed inevitable. I need you to perform miracles that define medical science. And I'm reminded of when Jesus touched the leper in Matthew 8 2:3 and immediately his leprosy was cleansed or when he touched the blind man's eyes and he saw or when he spoke to the man with the withered hand and he was restored whole like the other. or when he raised Lazarus from the dead after he had been dead for four days.

And I need that same touch, that same word, that same divine intervention to fall on my body right now to transform what seems unchangeable, to heal what seems incurable, to restore what seems permanently damaged. Because according to Malachi 4, two to you who fear my name, the son of righteousness shall arise with healing in his wings, and you shall go out and grow fat like stall-fed calves.

There are people hearing this prayer right now who have been given death sentences by doctors who have been told they have months to leave or weeks or days. And I'm standing in the gap for you, crying out for divine intervention. I'm asking God to confound the expectations of the medical community. I'm declaring that you will not die but live and declare the works of the Lord according to Psalm 118-17. I'm speaking resurrection power into your bodies right now.

I'm calling forth healing virtue from the throne of God. I'm declaring that the same God who raised Jesus from the dead will raise you from your sick bed, will heal your disease, will restore your health, you will give you years that you thought were stolen from you, and you will live to testify of God's goodness and faithfulness. God of divine intervention, I'm calling for divine intervention in my financial situation.

Lord, I need you to show up where my resources have been depleted, where my income has been cut off, where my investments have failed, where my business has struggled, where debt has accumulated beyond my ability to pay. And I remember the widow in 1 Kings 17 8-16, who was gathering sticks to make her last meal for herself and her son before they died of starvation. And Elijah asked her to make him a cake first.

And though she only had a handful of flour and a little oil in a jar, and she obeyed, and the Lord intervened, and the bean of flour was not used up, nor did the jar of oil run dry according to the word of the Lord which he spoke by Elijah. And I need that kind of intervention. I need you to multiply what I have, to preserve what I would lose, to provide what I cannot provide for myself, to open sources of supply I haven't even imagined.

I'm declaring that the windows of heaven are opening over the finances of everyone connected to this prayer. I'm speaking according to Malachi 3:10, that God will open the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there isn't room enough to receive. I'm calling for multiplication like the feeding of the 5,000 where Jesus took five loaves and two fish and fed 5,000 people with 12 baskets of fragments left over. I'm asking for provision like the oil in the widow's jar that never ran dry.

I'm calling for wealth like the riches of Job after he prayed for his friends and the Lord turned his captivity and gave him twice as much as he had before. And I declare that the divor will be rebuked for your sake and the vine will not fail to bear fruit. Your pants will be full and your vats will overflow with new wine and you will never lack anything that you need. I'm calling for divine intervention in my family relationships, Lord.

Marriages that are falling apart, children who have walked away, parents who don't understand, siblings who are estranged, and friendships that have been broken. And I remember the story of the prodigal son in Luke 15 where the father didn't just forgive. He intervened dramatically. He ran to embrace his son. He killed the fatted calf. He threw a celebration. He didn't lecture or punish. He intervene with love and grace and restoration. And I need that kind of divine intervention in families right now.

I need you to soften hard hearts, to open blind eyes, to unstopps, to bring people back together who seemed irretrievably separated because you are the God of reconciliation and nothing is too broken for you to mend. There are marriages hanging by a thread right now. Couples who are one argument away from divorce. Relationships that have lost all romance and connection. And I'm asking God for divine intervention. I'm asking for a supernatural move of God that turns things around overnight.

I'm asking for a touch from heaven that makes couples remember why they fell in love in the first place. I mightastically I'm declaring that what the enemy meant to destroy God will restore. What seemed dead will be resurrected. What was broken will be mended.

And according to Ephesians 5 25-27, husbands will love their wives just as Christ also loved the church and gave himself for her, that he might sanctify and cleanse her with the washing of water by the word, that he might present her to himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without blemish, so marriages will be cleansed and restored and made beautiful again by the power of divine intervention.

God of divine intervention, I'm calling for divine intervention in my spiritual battle. Lord, I need you to show up where demonic forces are attacking, where spiritual darkness seems overwhelming, where I feel outnumbered by the enemy. And I remember Peter in prison in Acts 12 when he was about to be executed. And according to Acts 12 7 to8, an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the prison and struck Peter on the side and raised him up saying, "Quickly, get up."

And the chains fell off his hands and he walked out through the guards and the gates opened of their own accord. And that's the kind of divine intervention I need. I need you to send angelic reinforcement to break chains that have bound me to open doors that have been locked to deliver me from the enemy's grasp because you have all authority in heaven and on earth and every demon must bow to your name. I'm declaring war on every demon assigned against those connected to this prayer.

every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of murder, every spirit of theft, every spirit of deception, every spirit of disease, every spirit of poverty, every spirit of suicide. And I'm asking God for divine intervention to cast them down, to break their power, to render them ineffective according to 2 Corinthians 10:4-5. The weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty in God.

For pulling down strongholds, has ten down arguments, and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. So, I'm pulling down every stronghold of the enemy. I'm casting down every argument against God's word. I'm bringing every thought into captivity to obey Christ. And I'm asking for divine intervention to complete the victory that Jesus already won at the cross.

I'm calling for divine intervention in my career and calling Lord doors that are closed, opportunities that seem impossible, positions that are out of reach, dreams that have been deferred, purposes that have been delayed. And I remember Joseph in Genesis 41 who went from the prison to the palace. From being forgotten to being remembered, from having nothing to having authority over all Egypt. Because God intervene. Because at the right time, Pharaoh remembered him and called for him.

And he was elevated overnight from prisoner to prime minister. And I need that kind of intervention. I need you to cause forgotten doors to suddenly open. I need you to cause forgotten names to be remembered. I need you to elevate me from obscurity to prominence, from struggle to success, from waiting to walking into my purpose.

Because according to Ecclesiastes 9 11, the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, nor bread to the wise, nor riches to men of understanding, nor favor to men of skill, but time and chance happened to them all. But I'm not leaving it to time and chance. I'm crying out for divine intervention. God of divine intervention. I'm calling for divine intervention in my legal battles. Lord, I need you to show up in courtrooms and council chambers.

I need you to soften the hearts of judges, to grant wisdom to attorneys, to expose the lies of accusers, to vindicate me before those who have tried to destroy me. And I remember how Steven in Acts 6 15 stood before the council and all who sat in the council seeing his face as the face of an angel. And though they condemned him, God's presence and power were so evident that even in death, he saw a vision of heaven and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

And I need your divine intervention to be so evident in my legal situation that everyone involved recognizes that God is fighting for me, that heaven is backing me up, that I cannot be defeated because the Lord is my defender. I declare according to Isaiah 54-17 that no weapon formed against me shall prosper and every tongue which rises against me in judgment I shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and their righteousness is from you. So let divine intervention expose every false witness.

Let it reveal every hidden agenda. Let it prove every lie. Let it vindicates the innocent and condemn the guilty. And let justice prevail in every courtroom where the people of God stand trial. Let judges be moved by the Holy Spirit to make righteous decisions. Let lawyers be given wisdom beyond human understanding to present cases that cannot be refuted. And let the world see that God is real and righteous and he defends his people. I'm calling for divine intervention to break addictions and bondages.

Lord, chains that have held people for years or decades. Habits that seem impossible to break. Compulsions that seem irresistible. families being destroyed by substance abuse, lives being wasted on destructive behaviors. And I remember the demoniac in Mark 5 who lived among the tombs crying out and cutting himself with stones possessed by thousands of demons completely out of control. But according to Mark 5 11-12, when Jesus intervened, the unclean spirits begged him, saying, "Send us to the swine."

And immediately the man was clothed and in his right mind and sitting at the feet of Jesus. And that's the kind of divine intervention I'm asking for. Immediate deliverance, complete freedom, instantaneous healing because you are the God who breaks chains and sets captives free according to Isaiah 61:1. I'm standing in prayer for every person bound by addiction right now.

every parent watching their child destroy themselves, every spouse watching their partner disappear into their addiction, and I'm crying out for divine intervention. I'm asking God to break these chains right now to set the captives free right now to deliver the addicted right now. And I declare that the power of addiction is broken. The grip of substance abuse is loosened.

The hold of compulsive behavior is released and freedom comes not through rehabilitation alone but through the power of the God who can do the impossible, who can deliver instantly, who can transform completely. And I speak to every addict reading this that your chain breaker is here, your deliverer is present, your God is ready to intervene. God of divine intervention, I'm calling for divine intervention in my city and nation.

Lord, corruption that seems entrenched, evil that seems victorious, sin that seems to reign unopposed, darkness that seems to have the upper hand, injustice in the courts, wickedness in high places. And I remember King Hezekiah in 2 Kings 19 when the Assyrian army threatened to destroy Jerusalem and all seem lost. The king and people were terrified. The situation seemed hopeless.

But according to two Kings 19 35 It came to pass on that night that the angel of the Lord went out and struck in the camp of the Assyrians 185,000. And when people arose early in the morning, they were all the corpses of the dead. And one angelic intervention turned the entire situation around. And I'm asking for that same kind of intervention in my city, in my nation. I'm asking for divine judgment on corruption, divine protection on the righteous, divine intervention that changes everything.

I'm declaring that revival is coming, that awakening is coming, that a turning back to God is coming, that repentance is spreading, that young people are falling in love with Jesus, that backsliders are returning, that the lost are being found, that whole communities are being transformed by the power of the gospel.

And I'm asking for divine intervention to accelerate this process to expand this revival to spread this awakening from city to city, from nation to nation until the whole earth is filled with the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea. I'm calling for divine intervention for the lost and backsliden. Lord, people far from you, people who have wondered, people who have forgotten, people who have turned their backs on you spell.

And I remember the story of Cornelius in Acts 10 where God sent an angel to speak to him and prepare him for the gospel and how Peter had a vision to overcome his prejudice and how divine intervention brought a lost soul into the kingdom. And I need that kind of intervention for people in my sphere of influence.

I need you to chase down the backsliders, to find the lost sheep, to bring back the prodigals, to reach the unreachable, to save those who seem beyond saving because you are the God of the second chance and the third and the fourth and the hundth chance. And according to one Timothy 2:4, you desire all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth. So intervene in the lives of the lost. visit them with dreams and visions and divine encounters that turn them around.

God of divine intervention, I'm calling for divine intervention to multiply what I'm giving, to bless what I'm sowing, to return what I'm investing. And I remember the principle in Malachi 3 10 where you said if I would bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, you would open the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there isn't room enough to receive. And I'm bringing what I have. I'm giving what you've given me.

And I'm asking for divine intervention to multiply it, to bless it, to use it in ways that impact eternity, to turn it into blessings for others that come back as blessings for me. Because according to Luke 6:38, give and it will be given to you good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be put into your bosom. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you. I'm declaring that seeds sown in faith will produce harvests beyond imagination.

That investments made in the kingdom will return multiplied. That sacrifice made for God's purposes will be rewarded abundantly. That those who give generously will receive generously. That those who plant in tears will reap in joy because God is not unjust to forget our work and labor of love which we have shown toward his name according to Hebrews 6:10.

And I'm asking for divine intervention to ensure that every good deed is rewarded, every sacrifice is honored, every faithfulness is remembered, and every faithful servant is blessed beyond measure. So, Father, I'm standing before you right now acknowledging that I cannot handle this alone, that my strength is insufficient, that my wisdom is limited, that my resources are depleted. And I'm asking for divine intervention. I'm crying out for you to show up, to step in, to move mightily, to do what only you can do.

And according to Ephesians 3 20, you are able to do exceeding abundantly above all that I ask or think according to the power that works in me. So walk that power in my situation right now. Intervene in ways that astound me. Move in ways that prove your reality. Act in ways that change everything. Intervene in ways that silence every skeptic. Move in ways that demonstrate your power. Walk in ways that glorify your name because I believe that you hear me. I believe that you care. I believe that you will intervene.

I believe that my story is not over. I believe that my best days are ahead. I believe that what you've started, you will finish in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. The name above every name. The name at which every knee bows and every tongue confesses. In that name I pray with confidence and expectation that you will intervene divinely in my situation. Amen. And amen. And amen.
